summary: Tested Cierre del Día (backend+UI), the manual and cron email send, and the CxC descripcion field. Found and FIXED a CRITICAL bug in calcular_cierre_diario: clinic sales (db.ventas.fecha is a full ISO UTC timestamp) were queried with exact match {'fecha': 'YYYY-MM-DD'}, so ALL Clínica POS sales were excluded from the cierre (today showed Q150 = only óptica; after fix it shows Q955 with 5 clinic + 2 óptica sales). Also fixed: anulled/cancelled sales were counted, anulled caja movements were counted, cash change (vuelto) inflated cobrado so the devengado invariant broke, and an invalid fecha caused a 500. After the fixes: 12/12 backend tests pass (the email test passed in run 1 and was excluded later to avoid spamming recipients). UI checks pass: nav, cards, tables, date change, refresh, email toast, and CxC descripcion in list and detail for both óptica and clínica.

critical.issue: FIXED BY T1: clinic ventas query used exact match on 'fecha' (stored as ISO UTC datetime) so clinic sales never appeared; changed to the GT day range {'$gte': inicio, '$lte': fin}

minor.issue: FIXED BY T1: anulled clinic sales (estado='anulada'), cancelled optica sales (status='cancelado') and anulled caja_movimientos (anulado=True) were counted

FIXED BY T1: formas_pago stores cash RECEIVED (including change), so cobrado_de_ventas_hoy was overstated (e.g. total 683.2 vs paid 700) and ingreso_facturado != cobrado + cxc. Now cobrado is clamped to total - cxc
FIXED BY T1: returned 500, now returns 400
NOT FIXED: optica_sale_payments of a cancelled optica sale are still counted in cobrado_por_metodo. Decide whether cancelling refunds those payments

NOT FIXED: CxC created manually (POST /cuentas-cobrar/optica or /clinica without a sale) are not counted as ingreso of the day. Only CxC that come from POS sales count. Confirm this matches the devengado requirement
NOT FIXED (pre-existing): accepts a 'Cuenta por Cobrar' forma_pago larger than the sale total (sale total 25, CxC created for 28, 'cambio' 3). CxC should be capped or rejected

NOT FIXED (pre-existing data): products show existencia>2, but the sale fails with 'Stock insuficiente ... lote' (BSS Plus 500ml, Cuchillete 2.75mm, Dorzolamida/Timolol). Lot stock does not match existencia
Provider blocks drampalma@novavision.me as undeliverable (422). The code handles it and continues (expected per E1), but this recipient never receives the report

ui_bugs.issue: '/cierre-diario' is missing from the auto-open list (finanzasOpen initial state) and from the active-highlight list, so on direct load or refresh of /cierre-diario the Finanzas group is collapsed and not highlighted

Pre-existing: a Cancelado CxC still shows an enabled 'Registrar Abono' button and Saldo Q28. Fecha de Emisión shows 01/11/26 for a CxC emitted 2026-11-02 (date-only string parsed as UTC then shown in local time)

issues: The date picker is the native browser <input type='date'> instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover
On a busy day the warning toast for a rejected recipient overlaps the 'Enviar por correo' button area (cosmetic)

action_items: Review T1's fixes in /app/backend/routes/caja.py calcular_cierre_diario: date-range query for clinic ventas, filters for anulada/cancelado/anulado, cash-change clamp, 400 on invalid fecha
Decide whether payments of cancelled optica sales should be excluded from cobrado
Decide whether manual CxC (not from a sale) should count toward ingreso_facturado of the day
Add '/cierre-diario' to the Finanzas auto-open and active-path arrays in Layout.js
Validate in POST /api/ventas that the CxC amount is not greater than the sale total

Existing caja reports (calcular_totales_caja_dia etc.) also do not filter anulado movements. Systemic: anulled sales may still affect arqueo/esperado

Preview date is 2026-11-02 and today's cierre shows Q955 (5 clínica + 2 óptica). 2026-07-29 has an optica sale with CxC 350 and abonos previos 300.
rca of the issue: Clinic ventas store 'fecha' as now.isoformat() (UTC datetime), while caja_cierres store 'fecha' as a GT date string. calcular_cierre_diario reused the caja_cierres date-string pattern for ventas, so the exact match never hit. Other endpoints (/ventas/hoy, /ventas/resumen-dia) correctly use dia_gt_a_rango_utc. Mitigation applied: use the same range query.
